description: This source file defines data structures and functions related to MCP (possibly 'Management Control Plane') health monitoring, including UI representations, raw data models, transformation functions based on display modes, and utility helpers for server status icons, colors, and uptime formatting.

classes.name: MCPSummaryForUI
classes.description: Represents MCP health summary optimized for UI display, including overall health metrics and status.

classes.name: AgentNodeDetailsForUI
classes.description: Contains detailed information about an agent node, including MCP data if applicable.

classes.name: MCPServerHealthForUI
classes.description: Represents individual MCP server health info for UI, including visual indicators and uptime.

classes.name: CachedMCPHealth
classes.description: Cached MCP health data with timestamp and node identification.

classes.name: MCPHealthResponseData
classes.description: Raw MCP health data received from the agent, including server list and summary.

classes.name: MCPServerHealthData
classes.description: Raw data representing individual MCP server health metrics.

classes.name: MCPSummaryData
classes.description: Raw summary data for MCP health, used as source for transformation.

methods.name: TransformMCPHealthForMode
methods.description: Transforms raw MCP health data into UI-friendly summary and server list based on mode.

methods.name: getStatusIcon
methods.description: Returns icon name based on server status for UI representation.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Returns color code based on server status for UI representation.

methods.name: formatUptime
methods.description: Formats server start time into a human-readable uptime string.
